checks.name: Public defer/accept of both optional recruits, no reward or duplicate recruitment marker, actual Garrus/Wrex squad and Citadel/Normandy revisits
Both public Garrus advice branches persist, follow-up reflects the exact selected choice and repeat conversation offers no conflicting reply or reward
Public early/late Liara dialogue follows actual completed-order fixtures, has no premature Vigil/Cipher topic, and survives actual automatic-save reload
Both public Virmire survivors react to the correct loss; dead crew stay unselectable and absent from conversations while prior exchanges and journal consequences persist through real reload
Both public queen decisions produce their own persistent/exported consequence, one native chapter reward and an unchanged actual reload without inventing later-media outcomes
Public 5/6-point persuasion boundaries display both prerequisites, disable only locked options, execute an eligible choice and show the same reputation values in the journal

limits: Earlier chapters, encounters and dialogue history in fixtures are prepared through the native Node callbacks; they are not claimed played in this browser.
Position-only transfers derive from the immediately preceding actual public export; no walking path is claimed played.

The two persuasion fixtures explicitly prepare 5/5 or 6/6 morality points; these points are not claimed earned in the browser. Thresholds are the existing ATB adaptation, not original Charme/Intimidation talents.
All six planet orders, all nine dossier combinations, healing/Unity and exact body counts are native checks; the browser samples the public flows described in its checks.
Relations describe actual exchanges only. Full romances, exact original dialogue, uncounted individual colonist outcomes and postwar political composition are not certified.
